corrected_content.problem:
The vectors $\vec{a}$ and $\vec{b}$ are given in the picture below. Find the coordinates of $\vec{a}+6\vec{b}$.

![](images/56/56b10e759084da6fb21c8421bc9ff6d74aac2602df28f6c8e478bd874d7d6e9f.png)
corrected_content.worked_solution:
From the picture, we obtain

$$
\vec{a}=\langle -3,2 \rangle
$$

and

$$
\vec{b}=\langle 4,5 \rangle
$$

Therefore, to compute the result, we just need to perform the required operations with each component separately:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\vec{a} + 6\vec{b} &= ⟨ - 3, 2⟩ + 6 \cdot ⟨4, 5⟩ \\
&= ⟨ - 3, 2⟩ + ⟨6 \cdot 4, 6 \cdot 5⟩ \\
&= ⟨ - 3, 2⟩ + ⟨24, 30⟩ \\
&= ⟨21, 32⟩
\end{aligned}
$$
